title: The obstruction to intrinsic perturbation for $A$-hypergeometric series
summary: We show that, at a fake exponent of an $A$-hypergeometric system and for an ordered negative support family, intrinsic perturbation within $\ker_{\mathbb{Z}}(A)$ can produce a strictly smaller coefficient space than ambient perturbation, which answers a question of Okuyama--Saito. We measure the failure by an intrinsic-perturbation obstruction module, a quotient of two colon ideals whose graded dual is the ambient coefficient space modulo the intrinsic one, and we realize this module by two right-exact sequences involving $\operatorname{Tor}_1$ and present it finitely by two antichains.
